description: Radionuclide Releases - Nuclear Power Plants / Direct Discharge is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission | Commission canadienne de sûreté nucléaire. This dataset contains the total annual releases of radionuclides released directly to the environment through direct discharge (i.e. releases to water) of the nuclear power plants in Canada. This original radionuclide releases dataset of the nuclear power plants provides results for both stack emissions and direct discharge. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission | Commission canadienne de sûreté nucléaire. Its tags are radionuclides; emissions; nuclear industry, Radioactivity, Nuclear power plants, Pollution, Pollutants. It offers 8 resource(s) in CSV, ESRI REST, WMS. The portal shows 2024-08-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
